why.detail: The training objective is the hazard-inclusive Poisson-Bregman GM loss L = Lambda_theta - r*(log Lambda_theta + log p_theta(selected)). The EDITING deployment is a fixed-budget embedded jump chain that DISCARDS the hazard and acts on the canonical-successor kernel. Selecting a checkpoint by the hazard-inclusive loss therefore optimizes a term the deployment ignores. In run compose-v4-ringcore-v1-full-6428901-v1 this selected step 500 (predicted hazard 0.617 nearest the teacher 0.510) even though selected-mark probability improved 3.8x (0.0316 -> 0.1189) and atom_restate top-3 improved 0.208 -> 0.528 by step 2000.
why.separate_issue: The hazard mis-calibration (predicted ~0.98 vs teacher 0.510) is a RATE-CALIBRATION issue tracked separately. An editing checkpoint selected under this rule MUST NOT be used as the final timed de-novo model.

primary_metric.name: production_weighted_canonical_successor_nll
primary_metric.definition: L_edit = -mean log sum_{a : canonical(T(x,a)) == y_teacher} p_theta(a | x, t)
primary_metric.rationale: The controller acts on the canonical-successor embedded chain -- not raw mark coordinates and not the continuous-time hazard.

secondary_metric.name: balanced_family_canonical_successor_nll
secondary_metric.use: decides statistical ties on the primary metric

gates_first.hard_gates: ALL must pass (validity, cycle-rank, charge preservation, executor/successor match, kernel normalization, no over-40, grow dead, no NaN/inf, identity match)
gates_first.family_liveness: no enabled family may be effectively dead (positive target probability, non-negligible updates, non-zero canonical-successor mass, present in natural rollouts where opportunities exist)

explicitly_forbidden: selecting by the hazard-inclusive GM loss
using top-3 accuracy as the PRIMARY selection metric
modifying the GM training objective as part of this correction

corrected_run.early_stopping: DISABLED (--disable-early-stopping -> patience 0); terminate early ONLY for numerical or correctness failure

provisional_checkpoint_protocol.label: PROVISIONAL_EDITING_CHECKPOINT
provisional_checkpoint_protocol.after_corrected_selection: rerun every load-bearing controller comparison and regenerate final artifacts from that SINGLE checkpoint lineage
